provenance.note: The anchored set anchored-v7 (docs/calibration/anchoring.md) with the owner's capsule laid over it: the composition of detergents/finish-powerball-ultimate.json (Finish Powerball Ultimate, desk research, nothing measured: docs/research/detergent-finish-ultimate.md) and the protease level of a premium unit dose (liq.xProtease = 0.03; estimated from the active protease of a premium unit dose in its maker's patents, not this product's). Wash with a dose of 12.9 g (dosing.detergentMass, a machine value). Calibrated on the owner's own machine (docs/calibration/owner-wash-01-calibration.md; wash record owner-wash-01-egg-yolk-eco50, one wash of four plates): prog.soakDuty = 0.8, held in the anchored set this layer is laid over. ASSUMPTION, labelled as one: a heat-stable protease (liq.proteaseHalfLife = 7200). No source gives the number; the upper end of the bracket.
